<module id="signal_generator">
    <description>Generates a triangle wave signal by incrementing and decrementing a 5-bit signal named 'wave'.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <output id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">5-bit output waveform signal representing the generated waveform.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE">0</parameter>
        <parameter name="INCREMENT">1</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        reg [4:0] wave;
        reg [1:0] state;

        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                wave <= 5'b00000;
                state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        wave <= wave + 1;
                        if (wave == 5'b11111) begin
                            state <= INCREMENT;
                        end
                    end
                    INCREMENT: begin
                        wave <= wave - 1;
                        if (wave == 5'b00000) begin
                            state <= IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                    default: begin
                        // Default state should not occur
                        wave <= 5'b00000;
                        state <= IDLE;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Generates a triangle wave by incrementing and decrementing a 5-bit signal.</implementation>
</module>
